modules.name: FreeCAD
modules.summary: Core application module used to create App::VarSet parameter objects in headless documents.

symbols.summary: Create an App::VarSet document object by passing the App::VarSet type id.

symbols.signature: (type: str, name: str, group: str = '', doc: str = '', attr: int = 0, read_only: bool = False, hidden: bool = False, locked: bool = False, enum_vals: list = []) -> DocumentObject
symbols.summary: Add typed dynamic properties to a VarSet, usually in the Variables group.
Bind another document object's property to a VarSet property through the expression engine.
Evaluate VarSet-backed expressions and propagate the resulting property values through dependent objects.

objects.name: App::Document
objects.behavior: Owns the VarSet and expression consumers, and recomputes dependency updates after scripted changes.

objects.name: App::VarSet
objects.behavior: A document object intended to store named dynamic properties that act as shared parameters for expressions elsewhere in the document.

objects.name: Part::Box
objects.behavior: Example expression consumer whose Length and Height properties are driven by App::VarSet parameters.

properties.name: Name
properties.behavior: Stable internal object name used by expressions such as Parameters.PanelWidth.

properties.name: Label
properties.behavior: User-facing label that can differ from Name and should not be used as the expression reference unless it is explicitly quoted for label references.

properties.name: PanelWidth
properties.behavior: Example dynamic App::PropertyFloat value stored on the VarSet and consumed by a Part::Box Length expression.

properties.name: PanelHeight
properties.behavior: Example dynamic App::PropertyFloat value stored on the VarSet and consumed by a Part::Box Height expression.

properties.name: ExpressionEngine
properties.behavior: Inherited document object expression storage that records dependencies and is evaluated during recompute.

properties.name: Length
properties.behavior: Example dependent property updated from Parameters.PanelWidth during recompute.

properties.name: Height
properties.behavior: Example dependent property updated from Parameters.PanelHeight during recompute.

examples.title: Create a VarSet and drive object dimensions from expressions
examples.summary: Creates an App::VarSet, adds typed dynamic properties, references those properties from a Part::Box with setExpression, recomputes, and verifies the propagated values.

availability.name: App::VarSet document object
availability.summary: Available through Document.addObject with type id App::VarSet after the App module initializes document object types; dynamic parameters are added as properties on the object and expression consumers update on recompute.

anti_patterns.name: varset-label-expression-reference
anti_patterns.summary: Do not write VarSet expressions against a display Label when the recipe depends on internal object-name lookup.
anti_patterns.guidance: Use the VarSet Name in expressions, for example Parameters.PanelWidth. A Label such as Shared Parameters is presentation text and can be changed or duplicated.

anti_patterns.name: varset-stale-recompute-assumption
anti_patterns.summary: Do not assume a VarSet-backed expression consumer has updated immediately after property or expression edits.
anti_patterns.guidance: Call doc.recompute() after adding VarSet properties, changing parameter values, or registering expressions before reading dependent values.
